name: chocolate-mirror-girl
image_purpose: Apartment outfit post and fashion lifestyle visual

prompt.project_info: Create a raw high-fidelity full-body mirror selfie in a casual domestic apartment interior.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman matching the required face reference, wearing a deep chocolate-brown rib-knit short-sleeve mini dress with mock neck and visible vertical ribbing, checkered comfort slides, clear-frame glasses, long square-tip nails, and a small monogram-texture leather handbag held in her left hand. Her right hand holds a blue-cased smartphone.
prompt.composition_elements: 9:16 full-body standing mirror selfie with a slight natural hip shift, phone in the raised right hand, handbag at the left side, and accurate reflection. Include wood-plank flooring, white interior doors, one door with a supplied Hello Kitty sticker, kitchen breakfast bar, dark wooden stool, pink handbag, and miscellaneous counter items.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused neutral-warm overhead light around 4000K, natural garment-fold shadows, realistic floor reflections, casual apartment atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: iPhone 17 Pro simulation, 24mm wide-angle, f/2.4, 9:16, deep structural focus, visible natural pores and hair texture, subtle digital grain, no beauty smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A raw high-fidelity 9:16 full-body mirror selfie of one approved adult woman matching the required face reference. She wears a deep chocolate-brown rib-knit short-sleeve mini dress with mock neck and visible vertical ribbing, checkered comfort slides, clear-frame glasses, long square-tip nails, and a small monogram-texture leather handbag held in her left hand while her right hand holds a blue-cased smartphone. Keep a natural slight hip shift and accurate mirror reflection. The casual apartment includes wood-plank flooring, white interior doors, one door with the supplied Hello Kitty sticker, a kitchen breakfast bar, dark wooden stool, pink handbag, and miscellaneous counter items. Soft diffused 4000K neutral-warm overhead light, realistic fabric and skin texture, 24mm smartphone perspective, subtle digital grain, and authentic lifestyle realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, explicit body-part emphasis, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, invented logos, altered supplied sticker or typography, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, broken reflection, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, watermark, low resolution, blur
